assertion.rationale: F16: the databases array in infra/bicep/platform/main.bicep (lines 264-282) sets no shortTermRetentionPolicy, longTermRetentionPolicy, or requestedBackupStorageRedundancy for the Azure SQL database, and verification/layer-06-audit.ps1's V6.1-V6.4 criteria check SKU, auto-pause and capacity field-for-field but never backup configuration. CP-9 is tailored out of NIST SP 800-171 (expected to be routinely satisfied by nonfederal organizations without specification), but CMMC assessors still probe it. Here the retention window and backup storage redundancy tier are whatever the Azure platform default resolves to, not a decision this repo made, documented, or verifies.

recommendation: Set requestedBackupStorageRedundancy and a shortTermRetentionPolicy (retention days) explicitly on the databases array entry, matching the redundancy tier appropriate to the data classification in play. Add a V6.x criterion asserting the values so a future change is caught rather than silently defaulted.
